children: Malaysia's state energy firm Petronas on Thursday said it had awarded a small field asset production sharing contract for the Estuary Cluster to Harvester Energy (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd.
The Estuary Cluster is within the Malay Basin, a proven hydrocarbon province offshore Peninsular Malaysia.
Petronas also said it had handed over an enhanced 3D seismic dataset to Dialog Resources Sdn Bhd to support continued exploration and resource development efforts at the Mutiara Cluster.
